verdict.rationale: Kit exposes a REST API, webhooks, and bulk/async processing endpoints that let external scripts or CI jobs create subscribers, trigger broadcasts, and react to events without using the UI, which supports headless automation. However there is no evidence of a CLI, SDK, or documented CI/pipeline integration pattern, nor any mention of running Kit itself in a build/test pipeline. missing for 10: dedicated CLI or automation-focused SDK, explicit CI/pipeline usage guide, evidence of non-interactive auth flows suited for CI (e.g. service tokens beyond OAuth for App Store apps).
